title: Making space
for the real.
about.imageAlt: Wesley Deep Biswas smiling in a sunlit studio portrait
paragraphs: I'm Wesley. I shoot birds, bugs, flowers, whatever's around — I'm not picky. No clients, no bookings, no deadlines to hit. Just me with a camera, trying to notice things before they're gone.

Some days it's a pigeon on a branch that happens to catch the light right. Some days it's a bee doing its thing on a flower nobody else is looking at. Most of it isn't planned. I just walk around, pay attention, and shoot what stops me.
